$comment: Conformance traceability manifest (#245). Each requirement row maps one normative clause (or one facet of a multi-part clause) to its observable conformance assertion and the tests that drive it. Validated by scripts/check-conformance-manifest.mjs: unknown anchors, quoted clauses missing from their anchored section, duplicate IDs, missing tests, and coverage states inconsistent with their mappings all fail CI; rows not fully tested are the visible outstanding report, never silent. observation.local records this implementation's chosen behavior where the spec permits more than one; a local pin never becomes the protocol requirement. Rows whose applicability names a capability apply only where the deployment claims it: a runner MUST NOT mark an unclaimed capability nonconforming, and a failed SHOULD row is a recorded departure, not a hard fail. source.revision names the drafts revision the rows were evaluated against; the stale-text check catches edits, the revision identifies the edition. Each row's profiles array (enumerated at the top level in profiles) names which published baseline(s) the requirement applies to: a floor document beyond core carries only runtime-enforced, core carries both, and an empty array means the row's document sits outside both baselines entirely; profiles and applicability are orthogonal, since applicability already encodes election of an OPTIONAL capability.
